title: The Treasury's Two Keys
offer: Agent — a disgruntled clerk walked out the FRONT DOOR with the Master Tax Ledger and SOLD it. I want the heaviest lock coin can buy.
opener: HERALD — A heavier lock on a door the thief was allowed to open? Mayor, you don't have a lock problem, you have a RULES problem.
nextHint: Find the Mayor in the Great Hall
debrief: Interlock technical and organizational measures — locks stop strangers, rules govern the trusted, logs judge everyone.

steps.objective: Secure the Treasury against all three threats
